# proxmox_guest_migration (Resource)

Migrates a guest to another cluster node through `POST /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/migrate` and waits for the worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_guest_migration" "move" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  target   = "pve-2"
  online   = true
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Source node.
- `target` (String) Target node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to migrate again.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID.

### Optional

- `online` (Boolean) Live migration for VMs, restart migration for containers.
- `restart` (Boolean) LXC only: restart the container on the target while migrating.
- `target_storage` (String) Target storage for local disks.
- `timeout` (Number) LXC only: shutdown timeout in seconds.
- `type` (String) Guest type: `qemu` or `lxc`.
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean) QEMU only: migrate local disks too.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<type>/<vmid>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
